review_notes: I read the whole file. It has four thin wrapper theorems and one conjunction, all built on a shared hypothesis bundle. Each theorem has no concrete scalar type, structure or numeric constant that could be replaced by a class. I checked rationalFixedScaleLaw_of_published in RationalThresholds.lean and the FiniteMcDiarmidInput definition in SamplingConcentration.lean. The McDiarmid hypothesis already quantifies over all B and M, and it is the form the underlying lemma needs. A weaker hypothesis for hMC would need new mathematics. RationalThresholdsDischarge.lean has rationalFixedScaleLaw_of_published_proved, which does not take hMR or hMRT. This suggests some hypotheses in this file are unnecessary, and hMV is unused. That is a case of deleting binders, which the rubric excludes, so I did not report it. I found no justified finding for this rubric.
